quote: Alexander Grothendieck posed the Section conjecture in 1983 in a letter to Gerd Faltings titled 'Brief an G. Faltings'
note: The conjecture was originally communicated in a private letter in 1983. It was formally published in 1997 in Geometric Galois Actions, 1 (London Mathematical Society Lecture Note Series, vol. 242, Cambridge University Press).
